name: New plan installation
description: Take a newly onboarded sponsor from intake to 'Installation Complete' on the recordkeeper.

steps.name: Validate onboarding data
steps.guidance: Every required plan attribute must be present and well-formed before any outbound communication. If this check fails, it is routed to a plan setup specialist to fix the data with the sponsor.
checklist: At least one plan administrator with email
Fund lineup has exactly one QDIA

steps.name: Verify plan sponsor and authorized signer
steps.guidance: Confirm the sponsor's legal entity and EIN, and that the person who signed the service agreement is authorized to bind the plan.
checklist: Authorized signer confirmed (board resolution or officer)

steps.name: Create plan contacts
steps.guidance: Create the plan administrator, payroll and trustee contacts so notices and file feeds route to the right people.

steps.name: Review fund lineup and QDIA
steps.guidance: Check every fund is available on the platform and share classes are correct. The default investment must meet QDIA requirements so participants who do not elect are protected.
checklist: No closed or restricted share classes

steps.name: Send 408(b)(2) service provider fee disclosure
steps.guidance: The responsible plan fiduciary must receive the covered service provider's compensation disclosure reasonably in advance of the contract. Review the drafted disclosure for accuracy before sending.

steps.name: Send welcome email to plan administrator
steps.guidance: Introduce the service team, next steps and key dates. Personalise if the sponsor has special instructions.

steps.name: Install plan on recordkeeper (TRAC)
steps.guidance: Final review of the record sent to the recordkeeper. After this succeeds the recordkeeper is the system of record and the plan is 'Installation Complete'.
